description: The original Node.js web framework: `(req, res, next)` middleware on `node:http`. Huge ecosystem; Express 5 handles rejected promises.
Performance-focused Node framework with JSON Schema validation and serialization per route, pino logging and encapsulated plugins.
Web Standards framework (`Request` → `Response`) that runs on Node, Bun, Deno, Workers and serverless, with strong TypeScript inference and an RPC client.
Opinionated framework with modules, controllers, providers and dependency injection via decorators, inspired by Angular.
File-based API endpoints inside a meta-framework (Next.js `route.ts`, Nuxt `server/api`, SvelteKit `+server.ts`) deployed with the frontend.
Glue that connects a Fetch-style app to a platform, such as `@hono/node-server` for Node.js.
